<!-- pr-reviewer: a64d782e040299d6beb473bcc6c5efb68822bfc9 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one missed user-facing string; the rest is sound).

**What looks good**
- The WCS page does draw the work-offset dropdown right after `wcs_page` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:137-147`), and the Setups page draws the same picker (`setup_pages.rs:170`). Both hints point at real controls; the heights row is read-only (`heights_page.rs:108`).
- The new WCS-page line and the picker hover are true: the dropdown only issues `SetSetupWorkOffset` and the origin does not move.
- The comment above the changed line in `pages.rs` (~line 631) was corrected, and no existing test pinned the old text.
- No snapshot PNG changed. The diff is three string literals, one comment and one `#[test]`.

**Local results (trial merge with origin/main 4c3f7565)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 521 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `offset_hint_tests::offset_hint_names_the_real_pages_in_plain_words` | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/src/project/wcs_one.rs:125`: the load note still says "since v54 a setup has one WCS, and G54-G59 is only the word its post writes". It is a user-facing string with the jargon the issue targets, and the sweep missed it. Suggested: "...and G54-G59 is only the work offset its post uses". The note is returned by the load path (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:513`). Please change it, or say why it stays.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Plain-wording suggestions for the WCS-page line: "register" is clear to most machinists but "the G54-G59 slot this setup posts" or "the coordinate system (G54-G59) this setup uses in its program" may read faster. "posts" is fine in the Setups context; "uses in the posted program" is plainer if you want it.
- The MCP `set_work_offset` description (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:26`) and the `"The work-offset word to post..."` schema description (line 274) could be reworded without a schema change: only the field name `word` and the error text need to stay. Worth a follow-up issue.
- Test coverage: no structural/AccessKit assertion covers the new WCS-page line. A one-line assertion that the WCS page shows the dropdown and no "Setups page" pointer above it would guard the regression behind #876.
- The on-screen look (wrapping of the hint, the hover) was not hand-checked; no GUI was launched.
- `Changelog: none` is defensible for wording-only changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0e8e3603b186478bcf22da2fd7f4906dba131706 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Read-only re-check of the delta from the reviewed head a64d782e to 0e8e3603. Not rebuilt on this review; the author's results on this head are in the PR comments: camcraft-ui --lib 522 passed, camcraft-app --test mcp_setup 6 passed, --test one_wcs 8 passed, clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean.

**Blocker status**
1. `crates/app/src/project/wcs_one.rs:125` load note: fixed. Now reads "G54-G59 is only the work offset its post uses".
2. WCS-page structural assertion: fixed. `the_wcs_page_shows_the_work_offset_dropdown_and_no_setups_page_pointer` (in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/one_wcs.rs`) checks that the new line is painted, that no painted text contains "Setups page", and that the work-offset combo reads G54. `painted` in `structural.rs` became `pub(super)` so the test can reuse it; test helper only.
3. MCP `set_work_offset` descriptions: fixed. `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:26` now reads "Set the work offset (G54 to G59) the post uses ...", and the schema description at `:274` reads "The work offset to post (G54 to G59); null clears it." The field name `word` is unchanged, as requested.

**Delta check**
- No logic change: string literals, one test-helper visibility change, and new test code.
- No snapshot PNG in the delta.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code.
- Changed user-facing strings contain no "furniture", "G-word" or "work offset word".

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The MCP error text in `setup_tools.rs` still says "the words are ..."; the author kept it deliberately so clients that match on it keep working. Fine as a follow-up.
- The PR body still opens with "Draft." and the author's last comments say "Still a draft", but the PR is ready (flagged at the quick pass). Please fix the body wording.
- Process: the PR was flagged ready (quick pass on a64d782e) and then took the push to 0e8e3603 without going back to draft first, as AGENTS.md "Draft PRs" asks. Noted for the maintainer; it does not change the code verdict.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
